# Derivation: for every `model.language_model.layers.L.mlp.experts.E.{gate_up,down}_proj` entry, in index
# order (the verified payload order: layer, expert, gate_up, down), the quant type and data_size give the codec:
#   4  MQ4 expert: gate_up qt44 1740800 B + down qt53 870400 B   (6306 experts in the artifact)
#   e  E8P expert: gate_up qt135 870400 B + down qt136 435200 B  (18270 experts in the artifact)
# No other (quant type, size) pair occurs. Payloads are packed back to back, so a layer's arena is
# the cumulative sum of these sizes (e.g. layer 38: 881280000 B, the placement's 840 MiB per-layer charge).
# MTP experts use the legacy aggregates (891289600 B gate_up + 445644800 B down) and are not listed.
